title: A message about a summer camp
instr: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.t: You will hear a message about a summer camp. Listen and complete the notes.
Hello everyone, and thanks for your interest in our summer camp for young people.
This year the camp is at a farm near the lake, not in the forest like last year.
It starts on the fifteenth of July and lasts for one week.
The price is ninety dollars, which includes all meals. Bring your own sleeping bag, but don't bring a tent, because you'll sleep in wooden cabins.
Every evening there's a different activity. On the last night, we'll have a concert, so bring a musical instrument if you play one.
To book a place, please email our camp leader, Mr Hales. That's H-A-L-E-S.
Please book before the end of June, because last year all the places went in two weeks.

ev.s: a farm near the lake

items.why: Năm nay trại ở một trang trại gần hồ (năm ngoái ở rừng).

ev.s: It starts on the fifteenth of July

items.why: Trại bắt đầu ngày mười lăm tháng Bảy.

ev.s: Bring your own sleeping bag

items.why: Mang túi ngủ; không mang lều.

ev.s: On the last night, we'll have a concert

items.why: Đêm cuối có buổi hoà nhạc.

ev.s: That's H-A-L-E-S.

items.why: Tên được đánh vần H-A-L-E-S.

title: a phone message about a cooking class
instr: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.t: You will hear a phone message about a cooking class. Listen and complete the notes.
Hi, this is Paul from the Green Kitchen cooking school, with information about your class.
The class was on Tuesday, but now it's on Thursday evening, because our teacher is busy on Tuesday.
It starts at six thirty and finishes at nine.
This week you're going to learn to make soup. Last week it was pasta, if you remember.
You don't need to bring anything, but please wear old clothes. And the class is on the second floor now, in room twelve.
If you have any questions, call me on oh nine one, two two five, six six eight.
Oh, and the price is still the same, thirty dollars for each class. See you then.

ev.s: but now it's on Thursday evening

items.why: Lớp chuyển sang tối thứ Năm.

ev.s: It starts at six thirty

items.why: Lớp bắt đầu lúc sáu rưỡi.

ev.s: This week you're going to learn to make soup.

items.why: Tuần này học nấu súp; tuần trước là mì Ý.

ev.s: please wear old clothes

items.why: Mặc quần áo cũ.

ev.s: in room twelve

items.why: Lớp ở phòng mười hai, tầng hai.

title: a guide talking about a museum tour
instr: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.t: You will hear a guide talking about a museum tour. Listen and complete the notes.
Good morning and welcome to the City Museum. Our tour today takes about ninety minutes.
We'll start on the ground floor with the old maps, and then we'll go upstairs to see the paintings.
Please don't take photos of the paintings, but you can take photos everywhere else.
Halfway through the tour, we'll stop for twenty minutes at the cafe on the roof. It has a great view of the river.
At the end, you can visit the museum shop. Today everything in the shop is ten percent cheaper.
If you lose the group, please wait at the information desk near the main door.
Now, does anyone have a question before we start? No? Then please follow me.

ev.s: We'll start on the ground floor with the old maps

items.why: Tầng trệt có bản đồ cổ.

ev.s: Please don't take photos of the paintings

items.why: Không chụp ảnh tranh.

ev.s: we'll stop for twenty minutes at the cafe on the roof

items.why: Nghỉ hai mươi phút ở quán cà phê trên mái.

ev.s: Today everything in the shop is ten percent cheaper.

items.why: Hôm nay cửa hàng giảm mười phần trăm.

items.q: If lost: wait at the information ___

ev.s: please wait at the information desk

items.why: Lạc đoàn thì chờ ở quầy thông tin.

title: a radio report about a new sports centre
instr: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.t: You will hear a radio report about a new sports centre. Listen and complete the notes.
And now some news for people who love sport. The new sports centre in Hoa Binh Street opens next Saturday.
It has a pool, a gym and four tennis courts. The basketball court isn't ready yet, so it will open in September.
The centre is open from six in the morning until ten at night, every day except Monday.
For the first month, students can use the gym for free. You just need to show your student card.
On the opening day, there's a swimming race for children at eleven o'clock.
You can get there easily by bus. Take the number thirty-four and get off at the bridge.
There is a small car park too, but it is often full at the weekend.

ev.s: so it will open in September

items.why: Sân bóng rổ mở vào tháng Chín.

ev.s: every day except Monday

items.why: Mở cửa mọi ngày trừ thứ Hai.

ev.s: students can use the gym for free

items.why: Tháng đầu học sinh, sinh viên dùng phòng tập miễn phí.

ev.s: there's a swimming race for children at eleven o'clock

items.why: Cuộc thi bơi trẻ em lúc mười một giờ.

ev.s: Take the number thirty-four

title: a teacher talking about a school trip
instr: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.t: You will hear a teacher talking about a school trip. Listen and complete the notes.
Listen, everyone. Here's the information about next week's school trip to the science park.
We're going on Friday, not Thursday, because the park is closed on Thursdays.
The bus leaves from the school gate at a quarter past eight. Please don't be late.
The trip costs fifteen dollars. Please give the money to your class teacher by Wednesday.
Bring a packed lunch and a hat, because we'll be outside for most of the day.
We'll be back at school at four o'clock. If your parents want more information, they can call Mrs Nguyen in the school office.
Remember, the trip is not just for fun. You will write about it in our next lesson, so take some notes.

ev.s: We're going on Friday, not Thursday

items.why: Chuyến đi vào thứ Sáu, vì thứ Năm công viên đóng cửa.

ev.s: at a quarter past eight

items.why: Xe đi lúc tám giờ mười lăm.

ev.s: The trip costs fifteen dollars.

items.why: Chuyến đi hết mười lăm đô.

items.q: Bring: a packed lunch and a ___

ev.s: Bring a packed lunch and a hat

items.why: Mang cơm trưa và mũ.

ev.s: We'll be back at school at four o'clock.

items.why: Về đến trường lúc bốn giờ.

title: a message from a bike shop
instr: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.t: You will hear a message from a bike shop. Listen and complete the notes.
Hello, this is Danny from City Bikes. I'm calling about the bike you brought in on Monday.
We've checked it. The brakes are fine, but the back wheel was broken, so we've put on a new one.
We also changed the chain. The bill is sixty-five dollars.
Your bike is ready now, but please come before Saturday, because the shop is closed next week for a holiday.
We're open until seven in the evening, Monday to Friday. On Saturday morning we close at twelve.
Don't forget to bring your receipt with you. Thanks, and see you soon.
Oh, and if you want, we can also clean the bike for five dollars more. Just tell us when you come.

ev.s: the back wheel was broken

items.why: Bánh sau bị hỏng nên đã thay mới.

ev.s: We also changed the chain.

items.why: Cửa hàng còn thay xích.

ev.s: The bill is sixty-five dollars.

items.why: Hoá đơn sáu mươi lăm đô.

ev.s: please come before Saturday

items.why: Đến lấy trước thứ Bảy vì tuần sau cửa hàng nghỉ.

ev.s: Don't forget to bring your receipt with you.

items.why: Nhớ mang biên lai.
